reader.requirement: At --std 85 the NUMERIC class condition is true exactly when the operand consists entirely of the digits 0-9, with or without an operational sign as the operand's description dictates (unsigned: digits and no sign; signed: digits and a valid sign, + or - for SIGN SEPARATE, implementor-defined for an embedded sign; alphanumeric, group or reference-modified operand: digits only), over a USAGE DISPLAY operand (the paragraph's usage, alphabetic and signed-group bars refuse the rest).

edition-consulted.switches: dialectLevel < 2002 selects the 1985 operand rule set (Rules1985: usage DISPLAY only, COBOL6918; NUMERIC not over alphabetic or signed group, COBOL6917) instead of the 2023 SR set
asks alt.RulesAt(ctx.Edition.DialectLevel) and walks the group for a signed subordinate only when NumericNotAlphabeticOrSignedGroup1985 is in the set

reader.edition-search: grep CobolVersion/DialectLevel/Edition in ConditionRenderer.RenderClass, CobolClass.cs and ConditionBinder.cs: the run-time content test (RenderClass -> CobolClass.IsNumeric / NumIsNumericImage) consults no edition; only the bind-time operand screen does.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a non-DISPLAY operand (COMP, COMP-3) and a group with a signed subordinate are refused (COBOL6918/COBOL6917); later editions admit COMP and test it. The content test itself (this rule) is the same code at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb823 exercises the reference-modified slice only; not alphanumeric content with sign characters, unsigned vs signed embedded vs SIGN SEPARATE leading/trailing, group operands, zero-length ODO group, non-numeric content reaching a numeric item by REDEFINES or group MOVE, or the 1985 refusals

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.3.1.2 GR1  (6.3.1.2 Class Condition)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: The content test is one runtime predicate per operand shape: digits-only for a non-numeric-category operand (CobolClass.IsNumeric), the item's sign profile over the character image for a windowed numeric item (IsNumericImage -> IsNumericZoned), and a fold to true for a native carrier, which StorageFormPass.IsImagePromotable keeps sound by image-storing any leaf a character channel reaches (the group-MOVE probe confirms). The overpunch digit '3' in S9(3) counting as a valid (positive) sign is the implementor's latitude the 1985 text grants. Class f (largest value, size error) does not bear on a class test; e (files) not probed: a READ reaches the same image-promoted path as the group MOVE.

SIBLING LEAD (another rule, not this one): numb.cob at --std 85 and 2023: INSPECT SN REPLACING ALL '1' BY 'X' on S9(3) VALUE 123 leaves the storage '02C' (DISPLAY SN '+023', a REDEFINES shows '02C'): the 'X' is lost through a numeric round trip, where §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR2 says inspection 'begins at the leftmost character position of the data item referenced by identifier-1, regardless of its class' (cite OK  §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR2), so the replaced content should be 'X2C' and NOT NUMERIC; the NUMERIC test of the stored '02C' is itself right.
